name: FixedVersusMovingZeroLedgerCriterion
purpose: Distinguish exact-confinement ledgers from stagewise support-only ledgers in the RH root-composite route.

objects.A_Z_n: finite/visible zero-side ledger at stage n
objects.E_n: transport from visible stage response to completed response
objects.B_n: root-composite obstruction budget at stage n

acceptance_conditions.finite_completion: A_Z <= 0 at a finite accepted stage
acceptance_conditions.fixed_ledger_squeeze: A_Z <= B_n for all n and tr(B_n)->0
acceptance_conditions.exhaustive_ledger_squeeze: A_Z <= E_n^* A_Z_n E_n + T_n, A_Z_n <= B_n, tr(E_n^*B_nE_n+T_n)->0

nonclaims: Does not prove anti-invariant source coercivity
Moving finite ledgers are support-only without tail records
